text:
taylor: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we decompose the hotpath into a tiny fast-proxy (sync, minimal validation, KV cache lookups, model routing) + an async-enrichment pipeline (heavy decoding, logging, evals). Objective: cut p99 tail latency and make ownership boundaries explicit.

sasha: I'm supportive. Quick Q: what contracts does the fast-proxy expose? eventual consistency allowed for enrichments?

mohit: yes, enrichments can be eventually consistent. Fast-proxy should guarantee idempotent request IDs and a stable minimal response schema. async workers enrich events and write back to a tenancy-scoped store.

jamie: To reduce blast radius we should add circuit-breakers and lifeboats on the fast-proxy. If enrichment backlog spikes, fast-proxy should fall back to a compact model variant. Proposal config snippet:

```
feature_flags:
  fastpath_split_enabled: true
  fastpath:
    circuit_breaker:
      max_rps: 5000
      max_error_rate: 0.02
      fallback_model: "open-lite-1"
    observability:
      export_metrics: ["hotpath.p95_ms","hotpath.p99_ms","hotpath.err_rate"]
```

priya: Important: add a shadow/shim mode during rollout — fast-proxy responds the same way but sends copies to async workers. Allows perf and correctness validation without user impact.

taylor: Rollout plan I sketched:
- feature flag off in prod
- enable fast-proxy in shadow mode at 0% -> 1% traffic -> collect diffs
- canary at 5% with CB set tight
- expand to 25% then 100% if metrics OK
- fallback policy: immediate route to baseline model if p99 > SLA or error_rate exceeds threshold

sasha: Metrics & alerts we need:
- hotpath.p99_ms > 200ms -> page
- hotpath.err_rate > 1.5% over 5m -> rollback
- enrichment.lag_seconds > 60s -> alert but not page

mohit: Testing notes:
- add property tests for ordering under replayed events
- run end-to-end with synthetic high-QPS to validate batching and cache hit rates
- measure cost delta: tokens/sec & GPU-usage for async workers

jamie: Ops checklist for cutover:
- config toggle for fallback_model
- pre-warm KV cache with synthetic prefixes
- run small canary and validate histograms (not just averages)
- ensure canary has auto-rollback job if alert fires

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary job started for feature fastpath_split_enabled @ 1% traffic — job id: cb-2026-08-01-17

taylor: Thanks all. I'll update the RFC with circuits + shadow-mode + rollout steps. PTAL and leave thumbs up if you agree. :thumbsup:

sasha: LGTM :shipit:

priya: one more thing — add a data-retention note for enrichment store (TTL 7d by default).

mohit: also adding a migration playbook to RFC (read-only mode, replay rehydration steps).

jamie: +1 on TTL and migration playbook. Let's sync tomorrow for the cutover runbook.
